options.title: Organize Your Tasks
options.description: Choose how you'd like to organize your GSD tasks in Home Assistant

show_due_in.name: Days ahead to show upcoming tasks
show_due_in.description: Show tasks due within this many days (0 shows all tasks)

create_unified_list.name: Create "All Tasks" list
create_unified_list.description: Show all household tasks in a single todo list

create_assignee_lists.name: Create individual task lists per person
create_assignee_lists.description: Create separate todo lists for each person assigned to tasks

refresh_interval.name: How often to check GSD for changes
refresh_interval.description: How often to poll the GSD server for new and updated chores

refresh_interval.description: How often to poll the GSD server for new and updated chores

approve_chores.name: Approve chores
approve_chores.description: Approve chore completions that are waiting for approval. Give chore IDs, or set all to approve every pending chore. Needs a circle admin or manager token. Returns the chores approved and any that failed.

chore_ids.name: Chore IDs
chore_ids.description: IDs of the pending chores to approve, as a list (e.g. [12, 13])

all.name: All pending
all.description: Approve every chore in the circle that is waiting for approval (ignores chore IDs)

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: The specific GSD integration to use (optional, uses first if not specified)

reject_chores.name: Reject chores
reject_chores.description: Reject chore completions that are waiting for approval, sending them back to be done again. Needs a circle admin or manager token. Returns the chores rejected and any that failed.

chore_ids.name: Chore IDs
chore_ids.description: IDs of the pending chores to reject, as a list (e.g. [12])

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note recorded with the rejection

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: The specific GSD integration to use (optional, uses first if not specified)
